H1471.def-es: nación extranjera; de ahí, un gentil; también (figuradamente) una manada de animales, o un enjambre de langostas; nación, pueblo
outline: 1b) of swarm of locusts, other animals (fig.)

H1472.def-en: a body, whether alive or dead

H1473.deriv: or (shortened) גֹּלָה (gôlâh); active participle feminine of גָּלָה (gâlâh, H1540);
H1473.def-es: exilio; concreta y colectivamente, exiliados; cautividad

H1474.def-en: Golan, a place east of the Jordan
H1474.def-es: Golán, un lugar al este del Jordán
outline: 1) a town of Manasseh in the heights of Bashan east of the Jordan; a city of refuge

H1476.def-en: Guni, the name of two Israelites
H1476.def-es: Guni, el nombre de dos israelitas
outline: 1) a son of Naphtali and founder of the family of Gunites

H1477.def-en: a Gunite (collectively with article prefix) or descendants of Guni
H1477.def-es: gunita (colectivamente con prefijo de artículo) o descendientes de Guni
outline: 1) a member of the family of Guni, son of Naphtali

H1478.def-en: to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire
H1478.def-es: exhalar, es decir, (por implicación) expirar; morir
H1478.kjv: die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish.
outline: 1) to expire, die, perish, give up the ghost, yield up the ghost, be dead, be ready to die
1a) (Qal) to expire, die, be about to die

H1479.def-en: properly, to hollow or arch, i.e. (figuratively) close; to shut
H1479.def-es: propiamente, ahuecar o abovedar, es decir, (figuradamente) cerrar; cerrar

H1480.def-es: cadáver (como cerrado a los sentidos); cuerpo muerto

H1481.def-en: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
H1481.def-es: propiamente, apartarse del camino (para alojarse o con cualquier otro propósito), es decir, peregrinar (como huésped); también encogerse, temer (como en un lugar extraño); también reunirse para la hostilidad (como con temor); morar, habitar
H1481.kjv: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.
outline: 1) to sojourn, abide, dwell in, dwell with, remain, inhabit, be a stranger, be continuing, surely
1a1) to sojourn, dwell for a time
2) to stir up trouble, strife, quarrel, gather together
3) to dread, fear, stand in awe, be afraid
3a2) to be in awe, stand in awe

H1482.deriv: or (shortened) גֻּר (gur); perhaps from גּוּר (gûwr, H1481);
H1482.def-en: a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion
H1482.def-es: cachorro (como que todavía mora en la guarida), especialmente del león

H1484.deriv: or (feminine) גֹּרָה (gôrâh); a variation of גּוּר (gûwr, H1482)
H1484.def-en: {a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion}

H1485.deriv: from גּוּר (gûwr, H1481) and בַּעַל (Baʻal, H1168); dwelling of Baal;
outline: 1) a place in which dwelt Arabians; probably lying between Palestine and the Arabian peninsula

H1486.deriv: or (shortened) גֹּרָל (gôrâl); from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone);
H1486.def-en: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)
H1486.def-es: propiamente, un guijarro, es decir, una suerte (se usaban piedrecitas para ese fin); figuradamente, una porción o destino (como determinado por suerte)
outline: 1a) lot-pebbles used for systematically making decisions
2a) lot, portion (thing assigned by casting lots)

H1487.deriv: or rather (by permutation) גִּישׁ (gîysh); of uncertain derivation;

H1488.def-en: a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass

H1491.deriv: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז (gûwz, H1468));
H1491.def-en: to cut off, i.e. portion out

H1493.deriv: patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine;
H1493.def-en: a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh
outline: 1) a descendant from or inhabitant of Gizon (otherwise unknown)

H1494.deriv: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז (gûwz, H1468));
H1494.def-en: to cut off; specifically to shear aflock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy
H1494.def-es: cortar; específicamente, trasquilar un rebaño o rapar el cabello; figuradamente, destruir a un enemigo
outline: 1b) (Niphal) to be cut off, be destroyed

H1495.def-en: Gazez, the name of two Israelites
H1495.def-es: Gazez, el nombre de dos israelitas
outline: 1) a son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah
2) a son of Haran, the son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah (?)

H1496.def-es: algo cortado, es decir, piedra labrada; cantería

H1497.def-en: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
H1497.def-es: arrancar; específicamente, desollar, despojar o robar
H1497.kjv: catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.
outline: 1) to tear away, seize, plunder, tear off, pull off, rob, take away by force

H1498.kjv: robbery, thing taken away by violence.

H1499.kjv: violence, violent perverting.. gozal. See גּוֹזָל (gôwzâl, H1469).

H1500.deriv: feminine of גָּזֵל (gâzêl, H1498) and mean the same
H1500.kjv: that (he had robbed) (which he took violently away), spoil, violence.
